notes: The repository is FSL-1.1-ALv2 (converts to Apache-2.0 two years after each release). Our own published @nebutra/* packages are MIT and excluded from the check — see tests/architecture/release-surface.test.ts, which enforces that. Copyleft dependency policy is STRICTER than under the previous AGPL-3.0 license: an AGPL project could absorb GPL-3.0 code, an FSL/Apache-2.0 one cannot, so GPL-3.0 and AGPL-3.0 are now forbidden as dependencies. The CI job and local script both use license-checker-rspack via npx (not installed as a dependency).
